buildchain-channel.description: Buildchain runtime channel: auto, alpha, or stable

buildchain-alpha-contract-lock-path.description: Consumer-owned contract lock selected for the alpha channel

buildchain-stable-contract-lock-path.description: Consumer-owned contract lock selected for the stable channel

buildchain-ref.description: Official floating Buildchain channel, protected authority, or a temporary train/SHA for trusted manual validation.

buildchain-expected-channel.description: Explicit stable or alpha lane expected by a trusted channel router when the workflow shell ref is opaque

buildchain-expected-major.description: Explicit Buildchain major expected by a trusted channel router when the workflow shell ref is opaque

buildchain-contract-compatibility-policy.description: Contract compatibility policy: major-compatible, allow-additive, or exact

buildchain-contract-drift-issue-mode.description: Consumer issue behavior for Buildchain floating-ref contract drift: off, breaking-only, or compatible-and-breaking

runner-preset.description: Runner preset: github-hosted, kungfu-v4-self-hosted, aws-us-codebuild-linux, aws-us-ec2-windows-jit, aws-us-ec2-macos-jit, or custom with platforms-json

aws-codebuild-project.description: Required CodeBuild project name for the explicit aws-us-codebuild-linux burst preset

aws-ec2-windows-runner-label.description: Required unique card-scoped JIT label for the explicit aws-us-ec2-windows-jit burst preset

aws-ec2-macos-runner-label.description: Required unique campaign-scoped JIT label for the explicit aws-us-ec2-macos-jit burst preset

platforms-json.description: Optional custom JSON array of platform objects: id, name, runner JSON string, and optional githubHosted boolean

self-hosted-offline-fallback.description: Route each supported exact-label self-hosted lane to its GitHub-hosted runner when no matching runner is online

control-runner-json.description: JSON runner-label array for trusted control-plane jobs

artifact-finalization-command.description: Optional consumer verification command over final artifact bytes before manifest resealing

artifact-finalization-on-platform.description: Run trusted artifact finalization on each GitHub-hosted platform runner instead of the control runner

fail-fast.description: Cancel sibling platform lanes after a required matrix failure; false retains all-platform diagnostics

linux-container-preset.description: Optional Linux job container preset: kungfu-verify, none, or custom with linux-container-image

linux-container-image.description: Optional explicit Linux job container image, preferably pinned by digest

untrusted-policy.description: fail or skip when an untrusted fork event asks for build execution

publish-channel.description: Publish channel requested by the caller: none, alpha, release, major, or a custom channel from publish-refs-json

publish-refs-json.description: Optional JSON object mapping publish channels to allowed Git ref regular expressions

publish-source-ref.description: Optional source branch such as publish-gate/alpha/<line>/<version> to resolve and lock before build

publish-anchor-request-json.description: Required JSON request when publish-source-ref resolves to publish-gate/anchor

publish-registry.description: Registry recorded in the resolved publish source manifest

setup-rust.description: Install a Rust toolchain for native lifecycle jobs

rust-toolchain.description: Rust toolchain installed when setup-rust is enabled

rustup-dist-server.description: Optional rustup distribution mirror; empty uses the official Rust server

rustup-update-root.description: Optional rustup self-update mirror; empty uses the official Rust server

cargo-registry-index.description: Optional crates.io-compatible Cargo registry index; empty uses the Cargo default

verify-substage-evidence-path.description: Optional lifecycle verify substage evidence path produced by the consumer command

kfd-agent-hub.description: Agent Hub conformance mode: off or auto. Auto reads .buildchain/kfd/agent-hub.json and runs the fixed KFD suite.

lifecycle-timeout-minutes.description: Maximum minutes for the build matrix job and fallback timeout for each lifecycle stage

pre-upload-transport-smoke-scenario-path.description: Optional declarative demo scenario, relative to working-directory, whose transport smoke must pass before Linux artifact upload

pre-upload-transport-smoke-artifact-root.description: Artifact root, relative to working-directory, used by the pre-upload transport simulation

credential-island-macos-app-path.description: Optional exact .app path to seal for a protected macOS credential-island job

credential-island-environment.description: Protected environment used by the built-in signer; leave empty for caller-owned signing

credential-island-caller-owned.description: Seal and export the macOS input/runtime for a caller-owned protected signing job instead of running the built-in signer

credential-island-macos-platform-id.description: macOS build platform whose sealed app is admitted to the credential island

github-artifact-attestation-subject-path.description: Optional exact artifact path to bind to a GitHub keyless attestation policy after the final platform manifest is sealed

github-artifact-attestation-signer-sha.description: Exact 40-hex Buildchain commit containing the trusted reusable signer workflow

github-artifact-attestation-platform-id.description: Linux platform id that owns github-artifact-attestation-subject-path

release-candidate.description: Generate and upload a PR-stage release-candidate passport after the full platform matrix succeeds

expected-artifacts-json.description: Optional JSON expectation contract for final artifact files

process-summary-path.description: Optional process sampler summary JSON path, relative to workspace, to embed in final diagnostics

sample-process-tree.description: Wrap the build lifecycle with the process tree sampler

requested-parallelism.description: Optional expected build parallelism recorded in process diagnostics

artifact-compression-level.description: GitHub Artifact payload compression level (0-9); zero avoids recompressing release archives and reduces signed-URL exposure

artifact-signing-request-upload-no-proxy.description: Optional NO_PROXY value scoped only to Buildchain-owned signing request uploads; signed-result downloads retain the runner route

artifact-transfer-mode.description: Artifact transfer policy: GitHub-hosted platforms always upload natively; other platforms use github-artifacts or s3-to-github-artifacts

artifact-relay-s3-bucket.description: Optional S3 bucket for artifact relay. Empty may use BUILDCHAIN_ARTIFACT_RELAY_S3_BUCKET repo/org variable.

artifact-relay-s3-region.description: Optional S3 region for artifact relay. Empty may use BUILDCHAIN_ARTIFACT_RELAY_S3_REGION repo/org variable.

artifact-relay-s3-prefix.description: Optional S3 key prefix for artifact relay. Empty may use BUILDCHAIN_ARTIFACT_RELAY_S3_PREFIX repo/org variable.

artifact-relay-s3-role-arn.description: Optional shared OIDC role ARN for S3 relay upload/download. Prefer repo/org variables or secrets.

artifact-relay-s3-upload-role-arn.description: Optional upload OIDC role ARN for self-hosted build runners.

artifact-relay-s3-download-role-arn.description: Optional download OIDC role ARN for the GitHub-hosted relay runner.

artifact-relay-s3-oidc-audience.description: Optional OIDC audience for S3 relay roles. Defaults to sts.amazonaws.com.cn for cn-* regions, otherwise sts.amazonaws.com.

checkout-cache-mode.description: Locked source checkout cache mode: off, auto, or require

checkout-cache-mirror-url-template.description: Trusted local/LAN Git mirror URL template. Supports {owner}, {repo}, {repository}, {repositorySlug}, and {sha}.

checkout-cache-reference-repository-temp.description: Trusted runner-local bare reference repository template. Supports {owner}, {repo}, {repository}, {repositorySlug}, and {sha}.

checkout-cache-fallback.description: Fallback when checkout cache misses: github or fail

checkout-cache-timeout-seconds.description: Timeout for each trusted cache transport attempt

checkout-cache-github-timeout-seconds.description: Timeout for each GitHub fallback fetch attempt

checkout-cache-fetch-attempts.description: Maximum bounded attempts for retryable GitHub fallback fetch failures

checkout-history-mode.description: Locked consumer source history: shallow or full. Full retains ancestry required by source-history gates.

shifu-cache-profile-ref.description: Opaque trusted Shifu cache profile reference passed to lifecycle commands without interpretation

shifu-cache-profile-digest.description: Opaque expected Shifu cache profile digest passed to lifecycle commands without interpretation

cache-dependency-lock-root.description: Optional consumer-owned exact dependency-lock root bound into structured cache evidence

cache-toolchain-root.description: Optional consumer-owned exact toolchain root bound into structured cache evidence

cache-policy-root.description: Optional consumer-owned exact qualification policy root bound into structured cache evidence

compiler-cache-provider.description: Audited compiler cache provider prepared before build: none or sccache

compiler-cache-platforms-json.description: JSON array of platform ids on which compiler-cache preparation is enabled

compiler-cache-required.description: Fail the selected platform before build when the compiler cache cannot be prepared

gate-profile-aggregate-json.description: Optional qualifying buildchain.shifu-gate-aggregate/v1 JSON from the reusable Gate workflow

release-candidate-family-evidence-json.description: Optional exact Initiative-family release evidence JSON embedded in the release-candidate passport

BUILDCHAIN_PROMOTION_TOKEN.description: Standard Buildchain control-plane token used only for protected runner inventory, dispatch, and central authority retrieval

buildchain-channel.description: Resolved Buildchain channel: alpha or stable

buildchain-channel-selection-source.description: Evidence source used to select the Buildchain channel

runner-routing-json.description: De-identified self-hosted availability and offline fallback decision

linux-container-enabled.description: Whether Linux build platforms are routed through a job container

build-summary-artifact.description: Uploaded aggregate build summary artifact name

credential-island-macos-artifact.description: Uploaded signed macOS payload artifact name when the credential island is enabled

credential-island-macos-manifest-artifac.description: Uploaded signed macOS manifest artifact name when the credential island is enabled

build-diagnostics-summary-artifact.description: Uploaded aggregate diagnostics summary artifact name

release-candidate-passport-artifact.description: Uploaded release-candidate passport artifact name when release-candidate is enabled

release-candidate-artifact.description: Uploaded release-candidate passport artifact name when release-candidate is enabled

release-candidate-passport-json.description: Compact release-candidate passport JSON when release-candidate is enabled

artifact-coordinates-json.description: Producer-owned exact GitHub Artifact coordinates for every resolved build platform

build-diagnostics-summary-json.description: Compact aggregate diagnostics summary JSON with lifecycle, diagnostics contract warning, and sidecar manifest warning totals

trusted-event.description: Whether the event is trusted enough to run build jobs

buildchain-runtime-class.description: Runtime stability class: stable, alpha, authority, train, exact-sha, or development

buildchain-runtime-override.description: Whether an authority, train, or exact-SHA buildchain-ref override was used

buildchain-contract-lock-status.description: Floating Buildchain runtime contract lock status

buildchain-contract-lock-drift.description: Whether the floating Buildchain runtime SHA or contract digest drifted from the consumer lock

publish-allowed.description: Whether this event/ref may publish after successful verification

publish-source-sha.description: Locked source SHA used for checkout/build/summary

publish-source-tree-sha.description: Git tree SHA for the locked source commit used by release-candidate promotion equivalence checks

publish-source-locked.description: Whether a publish-gate source ref was explicitly locked

publish-source-channel.description: Channel parsed from the publish-gate source ref

publish-source-line.description: Line parsed from the publish-gate source ref

publish-source-consumer-version.description: Consumer version parsed from the publish-gate source ref

controller-plan-artifact.description: Uploaded build-channel-router controller plan artifact name

controller-plan-digest.description: Digest of the build-channel-router controller plan

controller-receipt-artifact.description: Uploaded build-channel-router controller receipt artifact name

controller-receipt-digest.description: Digest of the build-channel-router controller receipt
